artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 18.6 x 14.2 cm (7 5/16 x 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing confidently in a full-body portrait. He is holding a sword in his left hand while his right hand holds a staff touching the ground. He has a long beard, mustache, prominent eyebrows, and a composed expression, looking directly at the viewer. He wears a feathered hat, short hair, a cuirass with intricate details and pauldrons, plumed shorts, tights, and decorative shoes. He also wears a collar, a chain or necklace, and a grid-like background with minimal detail.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.artist: Karel van Sichem after Christoffel van Sichem I
artworks.description: The image shows a man in armor standing confidently with a hand on his hip. He has a beard, a mustache, and wears a cap with feathers. He is equipped with a sword and carries a staff. At his feet is a shield and a crown, and a helmet is placed nearby. In the background, there is a seascape with ships and a distant castle.

artworks.title: Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the chest upward. He is shown in a frontal position, slightly turned to his right, with his head further turned to the right. The man has a mustache, beard, deeply set eyes, and a determined expression. His hair is mostly covered by a cap with a feather and decorative band. He wears ornate armor with intricate patterns and floral designs. There are no visible accessories or objects held. The background features a simple oval frame with inscriptions indicating his nobility and importance.

artworks.title: Pope Leo XI
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of an elderly man, with a long white beard and dark eyes, wearing papal garments. He is within a circular frame with intricate patterns and symbols associated with the papacy. In the background, there is an open book and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Otto Leoni
artworks.description: The image is a sketch portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He has short, slightly curly hair, a receding hairline, a mustache, and a pointed chin. He is wearing a garment with an intricately patterned collar. The background is plain, with a circular pattern framing his head and upper body, and shading suggesting depth.

artworks.title: Walter Leslie (Count Leslie)
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a man from the waist up. He is turned slightly to his right, with his face looking towards the viewer. The man has a long face, aquiline nose, and a mustache with a small goatee. His hair is shoulder-length with a slight curl at the ends, parted in the middle. He wears ceremonial armor with intricate patterns, and a lace-trimmed cravat. There is an oval frame with Latin inscriptions around him, and the border includes various objects like scrolls and instruments. The background has intricate hatching patterns.

artworks.title: Leonard Lessius, Jesuit
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table with a book open in front of him. He is holding a writing instrument and gesturing towards the book. The man has a beard and mustache, and wears a cap, dark robe with a cape, and a robe. The table is covered with a cloth and has books, papers, and a crucifix. The background is a study or library with shelves holding books and scrolls, a curtain draping above them, and a crest or emblem on the wall.

artworks.title: Leonard Lessius, Jesuit Priest, Professor at Louvain
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in an elaborate, high-backed wooden chair. He is turned towards the viewer, with his right hand resting on an open book on the desk in front of him and his left hand holding a quill pen. The man has deep-set eyes, a mustache connected to a short beard, and wears a clerical collar, a dark robe, and a distinctive cap. He has a visible ring on his left hand and an ink well with a feather quill on the table. Several large volumes are on a shelf behind him.

artworks.title: Joannes Hugo van Linschoten
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest up, facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a broad forehead, pronounced eyebrows, a full pointed beard, and a mustache. His hair is neatly combed back, appearing short and wavy. He wears an elaborate ruffled collar typical of the 16th or 17th century, along with a buttoned outer garment with a decorative pattern. Around him are four illustrated oval cartouches displaying maps, landscapes, and ships with decorative borders. The background includes additional embellishments and nautical instruments.

artworks.title: Justus Lipsius, Historian
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated with his body oriented to the left and his gaze slightly to the right. He has a solemn expression, a mustache, and a full beard. His hair is short and neatly combed. He is wearing a formal striped doublet with a high, ruffled collar and puffed sleeves. His right arm rests on the chair's armrest, while his left hand is near an open book and a feather quill on the table in front of him. The background is plain with horizontal lines, and there is Latin text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Justus Lipsius
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a man with distinct facial features, including a mustache and a full beard. He is dressed in a dark, formal garment with an elaborate ruffled collar. The man is standing and gazing slightly to the right. In his right hand, he is holding an object that resembles a mask or a gloved hand, while in his left hand, he is holding a book. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Justus Lipsius
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man's upper body seated behind a table. He has a distinguished facial appearance, with a high forehead, short beard, and mustache. He is dressed in an opulent fur-trimmed cloak over a dark garment with a large, pleated ruff around his neck. Several stacked books and writing implements are on the table in front of him, including an ink pot and quill. His hands are resting on the table, with one holding a book. A decorative coat of arms is to his left, and the background is softly shaded.

artworks.title: Justus Lipsius
artworks.description: The image features a detailed engraving of a man's portrait, surrounded by intricate ornamental elements. The man is depicted in a chest-up view, facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has sharp facial features, including a mustache and beard, and short graying hair. He is dressed in a fur-collared garment with a high-collar shirt underneath. In the elaborate oval frame around him is the name "IVSTVS LIPSVS". Flanking the frame are two female figures holding a crown and a trumpet, standing on pedestals labeled "GLORIA" and "FAMA". Below the central portrait is a smaller oval medallion labeled "MODESTIA", showing a seated draped figure with a landscape background. The engraving is adorned with scrollwork and a Latin inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Henry Cornelius Longkius
artworks.artist: Willem Hondius, after Daniel Mytens the Elder
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a mustache, a small goatee, short groomed hair, and a slightly receding hairline. He is wearing a detailed outfit with a high, ruffled collar made of a rich fabric, potentially lace or fur. The elaborate clothing features intricate patterns, suggesting high status. He accessorizes with a chain and a medallion around his neck. The background is textured, and the portrait is set within an oval frame with inscriptions. Additional text below the portrait implies an engraved or printed artwork.

artworks.title: Charles, Duc de Lorraine
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person from the chest up, in a front-facing position but with the head slightly turned to the right. The person has a mustache and a goatee, with wavy hair styled to the side. He wears a high-collared jacket with a row of buttons and a sash. The background is plain, with a framed portrait. Below the portrait is a panel with text in French describing "Le Duc de Lorreine." No visible jewelry or objects are held by the person.

artworks.title: Christiana Lotharingia (Christine de Lorraine)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a person facing forward. The individual has a calm expression and is dressed in elaborate clothing with rich details and jewelry. The person's facial features include a long face with high cheekbones, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. The hair is styled up and adorned with decorations or jewels. Surrounding the person is a circular dark frame with floral patterns at the corners and inscriptions naming the subject as "Christiana Lotharingia Magnae Dux Etruriae."

artworks.title: Francis de Lorraine, Second Duc de Guise
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up, facing slightly to the right while looking directly at the viewer. His head is turned to the side with a serious expression, and he has a prominent, orderly beard along with short hair that is closely cropped around the sides. The man is dressed in armor, which includes a detailed cuirass that covers his torso. He is holding a rod or baton in his left hand, with his fingers loosely wrapped around it. A chain is draped over his shoulder, and an earring can be seen in his left ear. In the background, there is an engraved border with some text above and below the portrait. The area surrounding the man is plain.

artworks.title: Francis de Lorraine, Second Duc de Guise
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a man wearing ornate armor, shown in a three-quarter view facing right. He has short, curly hair and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. The armor is elaborate with decorative patterns, including a chest plate, arm guards, and a sash or belt across his torso. In his right hand, he holds a baton or rod, and a helmet with a plume is beside him. The background has horizontal lines creating a patterned effect, and the image is framed with a decorative border. The text "Franciscus Dux a Guisia" is inscribed below the image.

artworks.title: Henry de Lorraine, Third Duc de Guise
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man in a three-quarter pose, facing slightly to his left while looking directly at the viewer. He has a sharp facial structure with a slender face, a neatly trimmed short beard, and mustache. His hair is short and combed back smoothly. He is wearing elaborately decorated armor, part of which is visible covering his right shoulder and chest. The armor features intricate engravings and a large round shield with patterns, on which a scene of mounted soldiers with spears is depicted. The background consists of finely hatched lines, creating a textured effect. Along the top border, there is text likely naming the individual portrayed.

artworks.title: Henry de Lorraine, Fifth Duc de Guise
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man identified as Henry de Loraine, Duke of Guise. He is depicted from the waist up, turned slightly to his left but facing forward. The man has a full mustache, medium length curly hair resting on his shoulders, and is wearing armor with a decorative lace collar. One armored hand is resting on his hip. The background includes an oval frame with drapery and tassels, and the engraving includes formal text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Louise de Lorraine, Wife of Henry III
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person, showing the upper portion of their body. The individual is positioned facing forward with their head slightly turned to their right, wearing an intricate outfit with puffed sleeves and a high collar. The person has an elongated face, small, curved lips, and an elaborate hairstyle. A single earring is worn, and an oval frame surrounds the portrait with ribbons and leaves. The name "LOYSE DE LORRAINE DOVAIRIERE DE FRANCE" is inscribed at the top of the frame, with French text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Louise de Lorraine, Queen of France
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is facing forward with her head turned slightly to the left. Her facial features are sharp and defined, with a calm expression and high cheekbones. Her hair is styled in an elaborate upward manner, likely held in place in a voluminous form. She wears a dress with a large, ruffled collar that extends around her shoulders, and the outfit features intricate patterns and decorative elements on the sleeves. She accessorizes with a single strand of pearls around her neck and simple earrings. The background is plain with a frame of geometric patterns. At the top of the frame, text reads "LOISE DE LORRAINE ROYNE DE FRANCE," and there is French script at the bottom within the decorative border.

artworks.title: Louise Marguerite de Lorraine, Second Wife ofFrancois, Prince of Conti
artworks.description: The engraving depicts Louise de Lorraine, Princesse de Conty. She is facing the viewer with her head slightly turned to her right. Her facial features are delicate, with dark eyes and a small, slightly pursed mouth. Her hair is styled elaborately. She wears ornate clothing with a lace collar, intricate patterns, pearls, and matching earrings. The portrait is framed by text identifying her name and title. In the background are coats of arms in the corners, and the engraving is mounted on textured paper.

artworks.title: Louis of Nassau
artworks.description: The portrait engraving depicts a man facing slightly to his left with a distinct facial structure. He has high cheekbones, a prominent mustache, and a small, pointed beard. His hair is swept back from his forehead. The man wears an ornate, high-collared garment with a ruffled lace collar and a decorative shoulder piece. He is framed within a circular frame with surrounding text. The background features finely engraved lines, adding texture to the portrait.
